verdict.rationale: HubSpot documents a first-party REST API (Marketing Emails API) for programmatically creating, updating and retrieving marketing emails and their post-send stats, so parts of the product can be driven without the UI. The evidence covers only one API surface, with no CLI, CI integration guide, or auth/token guidance for unattended runs, and the OpenAPI probes returned 404. Missing for 10: a documented CLI or CI/headless workflow, service-account/token auth for pipelines, an OpenAPI spec, broad API coverage beyond email, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: You can use the Marketing Emails API to programmatically create, update, and get details about marketing emails.
To retrieve a list of all emails, make a `GET` request to `/marketing/v3/emails`
You can also query details about the post-send statistics of a specific email or set of emails.
